title: INFORMS Healthcare, Raleigh
summary: Presenting our work on telehealth and continuity of mental healthcare.
body:
I presented our telehealth and continuity-of-care project at the 2026 INFORMS Healthcare Conference in Raleigh, North Carolina.

The project uses a U.S. nationwide claims database and is joint work with Shenghan Li and Kingshuk K. Sinha.
